claims.text: AARO's director reports directly to the Deputy Secretary of Defense following a summer 2023 change from the USD(I&S) chain.
In summer 2023 Hicks took direct oversight of AARO, repositioning its director to report to her rather than through USD(I&S).

edges.label: took direct oversight; AARO director reports to her from summer 2023
edges.note: Weeks after Grusch testified, Hicks pulled AARO out of the USD(I&S) chain and made its director report directly to the Deputy Secretary of Defense.

title: DefenseScoop - Hicks takes direct oversight of Pentagon's UAP office
